+`Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Resources/ListResource.swift`

+Coverage: 89.1% (49/55 lines)
+
+Uncovered lines: 36-38, 75-77
+
+Add these tests. Do not change `ListResource.swift`.
+
+1. Lines 36-38 -- `public init(id:)`.
+   The memberwise initializer is public, but no test calls it. Build a
+   `ListResource` with an id. Make sure the `id` property holds that
+   value.
+
+2. Lines 75-77 -- `public var generatedContent: GeneratedContent`.
+   The CLI driver uses this property to encode the operation back to the
+   model-facing payload. No test reads it. Make a `ListResource`, read
+   `generatedContent`, then decode it again with `init(_ content:)`. Make
+   sure the round trip keeps `id`. Make sure the payload holds the `id`
+   key only.
+
+Put the tests in `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/`, next to the tests
+that are there for this operation.
